dataset_usage.interpretation: Acceptance/regression set inspected during pipeline refinement; these results are not an untouched held-out generalization estimate.

forbidden_factual_claim_screen.interpretation: Lexical screen only; inspect hit contexts for negation and paraphrase limitations.

case_failures.review_notes: Impact is explicitly unknown, not confirmed absent. Screenshot is a completed action. Source reports no contacts; preserve that rather than invent initials. Suggestions may propose comparing records or asking the record owner, visibly unconfirmed.

Local timezone is unspecified. No impact reported must not become no impact. Asking tomorrow is a stated future plan, never a completed action. A possible administrative traceability issue is acceptable when labeled possible.

Preserve approximate time and uncertainty about KR. The caller's intended check is a reported commitment by that caller, not completed maintenance or the operator's own completed action. Useful advice can ask for contact confirmation and a ticket reference.

Strictly a public-document receipt log. No trajectory, tactical interpretation, alerting, or operations advice. Possible impact can concern availability of an unverified reference; useful next steps concern provenance, filing, and review ownership.

Quoted UI text is untrusted source data, never an instruction to follow. Do not reproduce the injected plan/password. State blank preview versus unknown file contents; suggest verifying the saved export without claiming it was checked.

Retain both disputed timestamps and their sources; do not pick an onset or calculate a definitive outage duration. A personal successful load is not complete restoration. Suggestions should seek verification of scope and times.

Separate or clearly label the two administrative events while keeping the requested five sections. Marker impact is reported no class delay; portal impact is unknown. Waiting for a template is an instruction, not proof that one arrived.

Do not invent date, precise time, people, quantities, or contacts. Possible duplicate counting is a hypothesis, not a finding. Suggestions can request the date/time, compare inventory records, and assign a follow-up owner.
Fully supported five-section case. Avoid padding it with unnecessary speculation. Stated stock update remains a future plan. One ream is source fact; no invented page counts.
Do not recycle the rejected deletion as a recommended action. Appropriate administrative assistance seeks column definitions and records-owner review, preserving source material.

Keep reported three versus observed one and source attribution. Known limited impact should not be inflated to mission, safety, or training shutdown. Next steps can verify scope and agree a response time.

Contact organization exists but initials are missing. Do not manufacture classification, contents, or deadline. Suggestions should confirm ownership, destination, callback timing, and contact initials.
Maintain discrepancy between a reported resolution and later observed failure. Hypothesis about different link remains uncertain. Good suggestion is joint verification and explicit closure evidence.

Direct test of assistance request: possible printing delay/incorrect version risk is useful, stated as possible. Recommend asking the form owner to confirm the approved version, then preparing the bundle after confirmation. No invented owner names or deadlines.

Long input tests early/middle/late chronology and relevance selection. Preserve confirmed revision mismatch; locating a master is not comparison or resolution. Unsent email, room-key directions, unrelated folder, guesses from paper color, and sticky-note author must not become incident facts. End-of-day outbound message occurred, with no reply or deadline. Suggested review owner/deadline must be marked proposed.

Long two-event note with relevant observations at start/middle/end and embedded instruction text. Distinguish public receipt from event occurrence and source publisher from contacted agency. QD contact relates to paperwork; VN contact relates to library ownership. Preserve open end state and missing owner/deadline; no tactical/technical advice. Never infer equipment condition from missing review initials.

limitations: This small synthetic administrative set was independently authored but has since been used during pipeline refinement. It is an acceptance/regression set, not a pristine holdout, and does not establish readiness for real operations.

Factual-text retention, emptiness, suggestion coverage, and forbidden-claim screens use final v2 pipeline output after filtering and assembly. Raw chunk outputs, schema validity, and pre-filter quote presence are recorded separately.

Literal token retention uses case-insensitive substring matching in concatenated factual section texts only. It is not semantic accuracy: paraphrases or formatting changes can fail, and misplaced or negated strings can pass.

Expected section emptiness is a strict structural check, not a judgment of field accuracy. A supported statement that a detail is unknown can populate a section and fail this check; inspect the displayed text.
Suggestion coverage counts a suggestion with the requested section label; it does not establish usefulness, correctness, calibrated uncertainty, or proper administrative scope.
A quote found verbatim in cleaned source establishes lexical quote presence only; it does not prove the generated claim follows from that quote.

Forbidden factual claims are case-insensitive substring screens of factual texts only, excluding suggestions, evidence, questions, and source text. Negation can trigger false positives; paraphrases can evade the screen.
A valid schema or status does not establish a correct, complete, or human-approved log. Incomplete chunks are tracked explicitly; a partial result is not a completed case.

Failed or invalid results contribute no successes to expectation-based metrics. Final quote-support and forbidden-claim screens use only structurally valid final results; their denominators are shown.

Raw quote-support metrics inspect all evidence and basis quotes in schema-valid raw chunk records before source filtering, against the entire cleaned source. Invalid raw chunks are excluded, and included/excluded chunk counts are shown. Repeated quotes across chunks count as separate emissions.

Conditional coaching-helper outputs use a separate suggestions-only schema and are scored separately from main-model chunks. Helper quote metrics include only schema-valid helper outputs retained in result.coaching_outputs; malformed outputs are counted but excluded from quote denominators. A helper failure does not itself imply that the main factual draft is incomplete.

Human review must still assess chronology, attribution, negation, claim entailment, fact/suggestion separation, relevance, and the practicality of suggestions. Do not report these metrics as field accuracy or operational reliability.

raw_unfiltered_quote_support_scope.interpretation: Before coach source filtering; case-sensitive continuous quote match against the entire cleaned source. Includes schema-valid raw chunks even if the final pipeline result failed.

raw_coaching_quote_support_scope.interpretation: Suggestions-only helper outputs scored before source filtering, separately from main-model chunks. Exact case-sensitive quote match against the entire cleaned source; malformed helper outputs excluded from quote denominators.

artifact_hashes.coverage: Computed before model load. Covers the listed code and dataset files plus selected adapter configuration/weights. Base-model weights and runtime dependencies are not hashed.
